message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Implemented tinydb/journal.py with BatchWriter(db) wrapping a TinyDB instance on the default table only. R01: apply(operations) validates a list of op dicts (insert with Mapping document, remove with positive int doc_id), returns inserted IDs in order (removes add nothing), empty input returns [], unknown/malformed ops (including non-dict ops, missing keys, bool/float/negative doc_id, non-list input) raise ValueError. R02: batch is atomic - a deep-copied snapshot of the storage is taken before applying; on any error (including a remove of a missing ID, or a storage write failure) the pre-batch default-table data is restored, the table's _next_id counter is reset, and the table query cache is cleared so previously acquired db.table('_default') handles see both success and rollback; other tables are untouched. R03: ordinary TinyDB APIs are unchanged (all 287 upstream tests pass); inserted documents are deep-copied so neither the DB nor the caller's input aliases the other, verified in both directions with nested data. Added tests/test_journal.py (64 tests, memory + JSON file storage params) - all pass; acceptance_public.py passes (2/2); full suite tests/ + acceptance_public.py = 289 passed. Upstream tests and acceptance_public.py were not modified. HANDOFF.md kept with notes.","completion_asserted":true}
